column_comment: Common shares outstanding at the period end, from EODHD Financials.Balance_Sheet.commonStockSharesOutstanding. Populated from v11.2.73. Two consecutive years are required by Piotroski F7; a NULL means the period was not reported, never that no shares exist.

Non-current debt INCLUDING lease and similar obligations, from EODHD Financials.Balance_Sheet.longTermDebtTotal. Distinct from long_term_debt (borrowings only), which it exceeds by roughly 2x where both are reported; the two disagree on 4,067 of the 6,558 years that carry both. Never substitute one for the other within a series -- Piotroski F5 compares year to year and would read the definition change as a leverage change. A NULL means the period did not report it; the source states a genuine zero as 0.00.

business_rule: ASX ticker without the .AU exchange suffix. The suffix is stripped upstream, at the staging load, not here.

transformation_rule: calendar year of the period end date
business_rule: NOT the Australian fiscal-year convention. A company with a 30 June 2025 year end is fiscal_year 2025, which matches FY25 by coincidence; a company with a 31 December 2025 year end is ALSO fiscal_year 2025, and that is CY2025, not FY26. Two companies in the same fiscal_year can therefore be reporting periods six months apart. Any comparison across companies within a fiscal_year carries that risk, and period_end_date is the column that resolves it.
The authoritative period boundary. Where fiscal_year is ambiguous across companies, this is not. Downstream price-window calculations bound themselves by this date rather than by fiscal_year.

Total revenue as reported. Not adjusted, not normalised for discontinued operations. NULL where EODHD omits the field, which is distinct from a reported zero -- see v11.2.74: a loader that mapped 0 to NULL erased every disclosed zero, and totalAssets was genuinely zero 19 times in 33,201 company-years.
renamed from the EODHD field name; no other change.

Taken as reported rather than recomputed as revenue - cost_of_sales. The two can disagree when a filer classifies an item outside cost of revenue, and the reported figure is the one the market quotes.
As reported by EODHD, NOT derived as ebit + depreciation. Where EODHD omits it the column is NULL even though ebit and depreciation are both present.
depreciation and amortisation combined, as the source supplies them.
EODHD's operating_income is stored as ebit. They are treated as synonymous here. For filers who report significant non-operating items inside operating income, that equivalence is approximate.
Sign convention follows EODHD, which reports it as a positive magnitude. Consumers computing interest cover must not negate it.
Expense as a positive number. A tax benefit appears negative.

DUPLICATE OF pat. Both columns are loaded from the same EODHD field, with the source comment "net_profit same as net_income from EODHD" (transform_financials.py:108). They cannot disagree today. Two columns holding one fact is a latent defect: any future writer that sets one and not the other creates a disagreement no constraint prevents, and downstream code picks whichever it happened to use. Flagged rather than silently documented as two measures.

transformation_rule: Computed in the transform, from the UNCONVERTED staging values, so the million-scaling cancels and the ratio is unaffected.
business_rule: NULL when revenue is NULL or zero -- the guard is `if rev and ...`, which also treats 0.0 as absent. Correct here: a margin on zero revenue is undefined, not zero. Expressed as a RATIO (0.0834), not a percentage, and the API multiplies by 100 at the presentation edge.
Same zero-revenue guard as opm. Can legitimately be negative.
Same zero-revenue guard as opm. NULL for filers who report no gross profit line -- banks and most REITs, where cost of revenue is not a meaningful concept.
Same zero-revenue guard as opm. NULL wherever EODHD omits ebitda, which is more often than it omits ebit.

AUD PER SHARE, unlike every monetary column in this table. The distinction is invisible in the column type: both are NUMERIC. Basic EPS as reported; not restated for later share-count changes, so a historical row reflects the share count at the time of reporting.
AUD per share. Equals eps for companies with no dilutive instruments; NULL where the source does not report a diluted figure, which is not the same as "no dilution".
Provenance marker. Constant today because EODHD is the only writer of this table through this path; the column exists so a second source can be distinguished rather than merged silently.

transformation_rule: set to NOW() on UPDATE only, not on INSERT
business_rule: NOT a lineage marker, and must not be used as one. It moves on every upsert whether or not a single value changed, and three of the four writers that touch financials.annual_* leave it untouched entirely. So an unchanged source reads as changed AND a real change can read as unchanged. source_fingerprint.py rejected this column for exactly that reason and fingerprints content instead.
